scripts.dev: concurrently -n web,api -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @cali/mobile-web" "npm run dev -w @cali/backend"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @cali/types && npm run build -w @cali/utils && npm run build -w @cali/prompts && npm run build -w @cali/ai-engine && npm run build -w @cali/workout-parser && npm run build -w @cali/workout-engine && npm run build -w @cali/timer-engine && npm run build -w @cali/stats-engine && npm run build -w @cali/pdf-engine && npm run build -w @cali/database && npm run build -w @cali/backend && npm run build -w @cali/mobile-web
scripts.test: npm run test -w @cali/utils && npm run test -w @cali/ai-engine && npm run test -w @cali/workout-parser && npm run test -w @cali/workout-engine && npm run test -w @cali/timer-engine && npm run test -w @cali/backend
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w @cali/mobile-web && npm run lint -w @cali/backend
